messages:
maria: Heads-up: proposing an unpin of runtime 2.15.x for the 'safelist' model cohort tonight at 23:30 UTC. Reason: urgent memory leak fix in 2.14 -> 2.15 backport. Change window 23:30-01:30 UTC. Plan: canary 5% (15m) -> 25% (20m) -> 75% (20m) -> 100%.

jon: quick compat notes: SDK 3.8 is required for new runtime shim. We must verify both SDK 3.8.0 and 3.7.4 behave. If 3.8-only failures show, we gate.

priya: I'll run the quick regression set at 22:50 UTC against canary infra (small batch). Embedding/regression sets: safelist-embeds-100 and safelist-regress-smoke.

rob: Rollback criteria I want on the record: any OOMs on worker nodes, sustained p95 latency > baseline*1.8 for 10m, or >1% client errors for 15m. Also watch the "model.output_truncation" metric.

maria: add: if we see >0.5% semantic drift on safelist-embeds-100 (mean cosine drop > 0.02), pause rollout.

deploybot: scheduled unpin request created by @maria for 3188888888. Pinlist update: safelist-model-cohort -> UNPIN @3188888888. To cancel: /deploybot cancel 3188888888 or reply "cancel".

priya: smoke run (22:52) status: sdk-3.8.0 OK on X86 canary, sdk-3.7.4 fallback OK. KV warmup passed. Pasting embed diff: mean_cosine_diff=0.003, 95pct=0.009. looks fine.

jon: thanks. I pushed a quick patch to the obs dashboards to include safelist.trace_errors and safelist.kv_warmup.failures. Alerting: page on >0 errors for 5m.

eng-sre: Night coverage confirmed, I'll be on from 23:15-01:45 UTC. Rollback runbook pinned in #eng-oncall.

maria: docs/console blurb: "Runtime 2.15.0: memory leak mitigation for long-lived KV contexts; no user-facing API changes. Expect background warmups to re-run on first requests." Taylor, can you sync?

rob: small ops note: when we start canary, throttle background cache-prewarm to avoid surge. Use command: 
```
/infra throttle --group safelist --kv-prewarm 0.5qps
```

priya: queued the throttle and will monitor.

deploybot: deploy update: canary will start at 23:30 UTC, traffic plan as requested. Auto-rollback enabled. Status channel: #deploy-status.

maria: final: if canary stable at 5% for 15m and no alerts, proceed to 25%. I'll manually ack to progress. If anyone objects now, speak up. :slightly_smiling_face:

jon: ACK from infra.

eng-sre: ACK and standing by for pager.

priya: ACK. Posting follow-up logs after 23:45 canary check.

maria: thanks team. Starting preflight checks at 23:10 UTC.
